content: Omuntu orherekîrwe Nyakasane
Nyakasane anacibwîra Mûsa, erhi: «Ogendibwîra bene Israheli ntya:
“Mango hânabè omulume erhi mukazi wajira eciragâne c’okucîhâna emwa Nyamubâho”,

“oyôla muntu analekage okunywa idivayi na ngasi gandi mamvu galalusà goshi; arhanywaga ciru n’enkalishi erhenga omu idivayi erhi omu gandi mamvu galalusà. Arhanywaga ciru n’omurhobo gw’omu mizâbîbu, arhanalyaga ciru emizâbîbu mibishi nîsi eyumire”.
“Amango gâge goshi g’oku­cihâna oyôla muntu munyaciragâne arhalyaga ciru n’ehitya birhenga oku mizâbîbu
, kurhenga oku mogomogo z’emizâbîbu kuhika oku byûla byâyo”.

“Amango g’okucîhâna kwâge oyôla munyaciragâne, olugembe lurhankamugera okw’irhwe, kuhika ensiku zâge z’eciragâne c’okucîhâna emwa Nyamubâho zihwe, ayôrha mwimâna, aleke emviri zâge zikule ntyo oku zinalonzize”.
“Muli agôla mango g’okucîhâna kwâge, arhankayegêra
omuntu ofîre ciru n’omuguma”,
“arhankacîhemula ciru n’oli îshe, ciru n’oli nnina, ciru n’oli mwene wâbo, erhi mwâli wâbo ofîre, bulya okw’irhwe lyâge kwayandagalire omugisho gw’okumurherekêra Nyamuzinda”.
“Agôla mango g’eciragâne câge goshi ali muntu orherekîrwe Nyakasane”.
“Erhi omuntu ankafira buno buno aha burhambi bwâge, n’okwôla kubè­ muli lirya irhwe lyarherekîrwe Nyamubâho, anamôme irhwe lyâge oku lusiku lw’okucîcêsa; analimôma oku lusiku lwa kali nda”.
“Oku lusiku lwa munâni anayisha adwîrhe emunda omudâhwa ali, mahali abirhi ga mpingà erhi bânagoko babirhi ba ngûkù, aha muhango gw’lhêma ly’embugânano”.

“Omudâhwa anarherekêra ngûkù nguma oku nterekêro y’oku byâbà, n’eyindi oku nterekêro y’ensirîra, kandi anamujirira empyûlo kuli ecôla câha câge c’agôla mango g’omuntu ofîre. Olwôla lusiku olya muntu wajiraga eciragâne anashubirherekêra irhwe lyâge”.
“Kandi anashubirherekêra Nyamubâho ensiku z’eciragâne câge, anarherekêra omwâna-buzi wa mwâka muguma oku nterekêro y’obubî. Ensiku zagezire zirhankaciganjwa bulya eciragâne câge cahemwîrwe”».
«Alaga irhegeko ly’omuntu wacihânyire; oku lusiku luzinda lw’eciragâne câge banayisha bamudwîrhe ah’ihêma ly’embugânano.

“Anahà Nyamubâho entûlo yâge ntyâla: mwâna-buzi wa mwâka muguma orhalikwo ishembo, oku nterekêro y’ensirîra, omushîbuzi gwa mwâka muguma oku nterekêro y’oku byâha, nayo erhabâga n’ishembo, engandabuzi erhalikwo ishembo, oku nterekêro y’omurhûla”.

“Ahirekwo ecirhiri c’emigati erhalimwo lwango, migati ya nshâno ya mula mvange n’amavurha n’orhundi rhugati rhutya rhutya rhurhalimwo lwango, rhushîge amavurha, kandi banajiramwo enterekêro y’enkalangè, n’eya okushêsha ecinyôbwa, erya banakômerera okujira”.
“Ebyôla omudâhwa anabirherekêra Nyamubâho, anabulihâna enterekêro yâge oku byâha kuguma n’enterekêro yâge y’ensirîra”.

“Kandi anarherekêra erya ngandabuzi oku nterekêro y’omurhûla emwa Nyamubâho, kuguma na cirya cirhiri c’emigati erhalimwo lwango. Kandi omudâhwa anajira enterekêro yâge y’enkalangè n’ey’okushêsha ecinyôbwa”.
“Olya wajiraga eciragâne anamômera irhwe lyâge ah’Ihêma ly’embugânano, hano abà amârhôla zirya mvîri z’okw’irhwe lyâge lyarherekêragwa, anazihira omu muliro gw’enterekêro y’omurhûla”.
“Omudâhwa anayanka ecirhugo c’erya ngandabuzi nka camahya

, anayanka na mugati muguma gurhalimwo lwango muli erya eri omu cirhiri, kuguma na higati higuma nahyo hirhalimwo lwango; na hanôla abà amabihira omu maboko­ g’olya nyakujira eciragâne, nka naye amanamômaga lirya irhwe lyâge lyarherekêragwa”.

“Omudâhwa anabimogamoga embere za Nyamubâho: kali kantu kimâna k’omudâhwa kuguma na omushaya gubà gwamamogamogwa, na okugulu kubà kwamakobôlwa. Enyuma z’ahôla, olya wajiraga eciragâne anahashiginywa idivayi”.
“Lyo irhegeko ly’owahânaga eciragâne elyo, lyo n’irhegeko lyâge oku nterekêro ankahà Nyamubâho nk’oku ankanahashibona. Eryo irhegeko aliyûkiriza nka kulya anahânaga eciragâne câge”».
Isâla ly’omugisho
Nyakasane anacishambâza Mûsa amubwîra, erhi:
«Odese Aroni n’abagala, erhi: “Mukola mwagisha bene Israheli mwanababwîra”, erhi:
“Nyakasane akugishe anakulange!”
“Nyamubâho akumolekere n’obusù bwâge, anakushobôze engalo zâge!”
“Nyamubâho akuyinamulire amalanga, anakuhè omurhûla!”
“Ntyo kwo bâkazihira izîno lyâni kuli bene Israheli, nâni nanabagisha.”»

6, 6 Omunya-ciragâne n’omudâhwa mukulu (Lev 21, 1-11), bagwâsirwe okushimba buzira izâbyo amarhegeko g’enterekêro nyêrukwêru. Arhahîraga akacihemula (Rhulole omu cigabi ca 19).
6, 19 Amarhegeko gayêrekîre abadâhwa gahùnyire oku kuli kwinjà okuhà omudâhwa ecâge cigabi nka ciciri cibishi (Lev 7, 6.31-34; 1 Sam 2, 14-15).
